example.chinese: 我们四点在图书馆外见面吧。

example.chinese: 你介意把窗户打开吗？

example.chinese: 火车将在一分钟后到达。

example.english: I miss my old classmates very much.
example.chinese: 我非常想念以前的同学。

example.chinese: 我存了一些钱来买这本书。

example.chinese: 大多数孩子喜欢这场科学表演。

example.chinese: 请把箱子从门边移开。

example.chinese: 我们剩下的时间不多了。

example.chinese: 请把你的名字写在上方。

example.english: We should learn to respect nature.
example.chinese: 我们应该学会尊重自然。

example.chinese: 我家附近有一个小公园。

example.chinese: 上台发言前我感到紧张。

example.chinese: 我的爷爷从不浪费食物。

example.chinese: 冰箱里没有牛奶了。

example.chinese: 我写了一则关于实验的简短笔记。

example.chinese: 你注意到门边的新标志了吗？

example.chinese: 把你的电话号码写在这张卡片上。

example.chinese: 我们靠近时，那只鸟飞走了。

example.chinese: 米娅主动提出帮忙拿这个重包。

example.chinese: 我们放学后经常骑自行车。

example.chinese: 爸爸修好了那把旧木椅。

example.chinese: 把这些图片按正确顺序排列。

example.chinese: 一些学生阅读，另一些学生画画。

example.chinese: 孩子们在外面的花园里。

example.chinese: 河上的那座桥很古老。

example.chinese: 莉莉在自己的花园里种蔬菜。

example.chinese: 我们要画一幅湖景图。

example.chinese: 这是任务中最难的部分。

example.chinese: 她努力学习并通过了考试。

example.chinese: 世界各地的人们都期盼和平。

example.chinese: 这天气非常适合野餐。

example.chinese: 门口的那个人是我们的新教练。

example.chinese: 我们在老桥旁拍了一张照片。

example.chinese: 这张图片展示了一个热闹的市场。

example.chinese: 公园关闭了，真遗憾。

example.chinese: 这个安静的地方适合阅读。

example.chinese: 我们为学校旅行制订了计划。

example.english: This plant needs water and sunlight.
example.chinese: 这株植物需要水和阳光。

example.english: The children play together after class.
example.chinese: 孩子们课后一起玩。

example.english: Please wait for me by the school gate.
example.chinese: 请在校门口等我。

example.english: It was a pleasure to work with your team.
example.chinese: 与你们团队合作很愉快。

example.english: Please remember the main point of the story.
example.chinese: 请记住这个故事的要点。

example.english: It is polite to say thank you.
example.chinese: 说谢谢是有礼貌的。

example.english: Plastic waste can pollute the sea.
example.chinese: 塑料垃圾会污染海洋。

example.chinese: 这个项目帮助贫困家庭获得安全的住所。

example.english: Basketball is popular at our school.
example.chinese: 篮球在我们学校很受欢迎。

example.english: Is it possible to finish this today?
example.chinese: 今天有可能完成这件事吗？

example.english: Daily practice will improve your writing.
example.chinese: 每天练习会提高你的写作水平。

example.english: The teacher praised Amy for helping others.
example.chinese: 老师因艾米帮助他人而表扬了她。

example.english: I prefer walking to taking the bus.
example.chinese: 比起坐公交车，我更喜欢步行。

example.english: We need to prepare food for the trip.
example.chinese: 我们需要为旅行准备食物。

example.english: I made a birthday present for Mum.
example.chinese: 我为妈妈做了一份生日礼物。

example.english: She takes pride in her careful work.
example.chinese: 她为自己认真完成的工作感到自豪。

example.chinese: 我们一起解决了这个问题。

example.english: This farm produces fresh milk every day.
example.chinese: 这个农场每天生产鲜奶。

example.english: I promise to return the book tomorrow.
example.chinese: 我保证明天归还这本书。

example.english: Wear proper shoes for the mountain walk.
example.chinese: 登山时要穿合适的鞋。

example.english: Trees help protect the soil from heavy rain.
example.chinese: 树木有助于保护土壤免受暴雨侵蚀。

example.english: My parents are proud of my progress.
example.chinese: 我的父母为我的进步感到自豪。

example.english: The hotel provides free breakfast for guests.
example.chinese: 这家酒店为客人提供免费早餐。

example.english: This public library is open every day.
example.chinese: 这家公共图书馆每天开放。

example.english: Pull the door gently to open it.
example.chinese: 轻轻拉门把它打开。

example.english: The coach did not punish him for the mistake.
example.chinese: 教练没有因为这个错误惩罚他。

example.english: Push the box closer to the wall.
example.chinese: 把箱子推近墙边。

example.english: Put your books back on the shelf.
example.chinese: 把你的书放回书架上。

example.english: We had a quick lunch before the meeting.
example.chinese: 开会前我们匆匆吃了顿午饭。

example.english: Please keep quiet in the reading room.
example.chinese: 请在阅览室保持安静。

example.english: The rain stopped just before noon.
example.chinese: 雨在中午前刚好停了。

example.english: Please raise your hand before answering.
example.chinese: 回答前请举手。

example.english: The town has seen rapid change this year.
example.chinese: 这座城镇今年发生了迅速的变化。

example.english: We reached the station before eight.
example.chinese: 我们八点前到达了车站。

example.english: I read for twenty minutes every night.
example.chinese: 我每天晚上阅读二十分钟。

example.english: The story is based on a real event.
example.chinese: 这个故事以真实事件为基础。

example.english: I realised that my bag was still at home.
example.chinese: 我意识到书包还在家里。

example.english: Do you know the reason for the delay?
example.chinese: 你知道延误的原因吗？

example.chinese: 他拒绝抄袭另一名学生的作业。

example.english: I regret speaking to my friend so rudely.
example.chinese: 我后悔那样粗鲁地和朋友说话。

example.english: Soft music helps me relax after school.
example.chinese: 轻柔的音乐帮助我放学后放松。

example.english: Remember to turn off the lights.
example.chinese: 记得关灯。

example.english: Dad repaired my bike this morning.
example.chinese: 爸爸今天早上修好了我的自行车。

example.english: We wrote a report about water use.
example.chinese: 我们写了一份关于用水的报告。

example.english: Please return the book by Friday.
example.chinese: 请在星期五前归还这本书。

example.english: Let us review the new words together.
example.chinese: 让我们一起复习这些新单词。

example.english: I ride my bike to school on sunny days.
example.chinese: 晴天时我骑自行车上学。

example.chinese: 你选择了正确答案。

example.english: Everyone must follow the safety rule.
example.chinese: 每个人都必须遵守这条安全规则。

example.chinese: 我们每天早晨绕操场跑步。

example.english: Tina felt sad when her friend moved away.
example.chinese: 朋友搬走时，蒂娜感到很难过。

example.english: The children are safe inside the house.
example.chinese: 孩子们待在屋里很安全。

example.english: We chose the same colour for our bags.
example.chinese: 我们为书包选择了相同的颜色。

example.english: The final result satisfied everyone.
example.chinese: 最终结果让每个人都满意。

example.english: Turning off the tap can save water.
example.chinese: 关掉水龙头可以节约用水。

example.chinese: 请清楚地说出你的名字。

example.chinese: 突如其来的声音吓到了小狗。

example.chinese: 我们在房间里寻找丢失的钥匙。

example.english: Spring is my favourite season.
example.chinese: 春天是我最喜欢的季节。

example.english: The story keeps its secret until the final page.
example.chinese: 这个故事直到最后一页才揭开秘密。

example.english: I can see the mountains from here.
example.chinese: 我从这里能看见群山。

example.english: They sell fresh fruit at the market.
example.chinese: 他们在市场出售新鲜水果。

example.english: Please send me the photo tonight.
example.chinese: 请今晚把照片发给我。

example.english: Air pollution is a serious problem.
example.chinese: 空气污染是一个严重的问题。

example.english: She hopes to serve her community.
example.chinese: 她希望为自己的社区服务。

example.english: She set the cup on the table.
example.chinese: 她把杯子放在桌上。

example.english: Shake the bottle before you open it.
example.chinese: 打开瓶子前先摇一摇。

example.english: We shared our ideas with the class.
example.chinese: 我们和全班分享了想法。

example.english: Can you show me how this machine works?
example.chinese: 你能向我展示这台机器如何工作吗？

example.english: The room became silent when she began to speak.
example.chinese: 她开始讲话时，房间安静了下来。

example.english: This simple map is easy to follow.
example.chinese: 这张简单的地图很容易看懂。

example.english: I have known Leo since primary school.
example.chinese: 我从小学起就认识利奥。

example.english: We sing this song at every school festival.
example.chinese: 每次校园节我们都唱这首歌。

example.chinese: 如果你需要更多光线，就坐在窗边。

example.chinese: 烹饪是一项实用的生活技能。

example.english: Young children need to sleep well.
example.chinese: 年幼的孩子需要睡好觉。

example.english: The bus was slow in the heavy traffic.
example.chinese: 公交车在拥堵的车流中行驶缓慢。

example.chinese: 那是解决这个谜题的聪明办法。

example.english: These flowers smell sweet in spring.
example.chinese: 这些花在春天闻起来很香。

example.english: The stone feels cool and smooth.
example.chinese: 这块石头摸起来清凉又光滑。

example.english: It was raining, so we stayed indoors.
example.chinese: 当时在下雨，所以我们待在室内。

example.english: The kitten has warm, soft fur.
example.chinese: 这只小猫有温暖柔软的毛。

example.english: Can you solve this maths problem?
example.chinese: 你能解出这道数学题吗？

example.english: The doctor will see you soon.
example.chinese: 医生很快就会为你诊治。

example.english: We heard a strange sound outside.
example.chinese: 我们听到外面有奇怪的声音。

example.english: There is enough space for another chair.
example.chinese: 这里有足够空间再放一把椅子。

example.english: Please speak slowly and clearly.
example.chinese: 请说得慢一些、清楚一些。

example.english: Today is a special day for our family.
example.chinese: 今天对我们家来说是特别的一天。

example.english: I spend an hour reading each evening.
example.chinese: 我每天晚上花一小时阅读。

example.english: Team spirit helped us finish the race.
example.chinese: 团队精神帮助我们完成了比赛。

example.english: Swimming is her favourite sport.
example.chinese: 游泳是她最喜欢的体育运动。

example.english: Good news spread quickly through the school.
example.chinese: 好消息很快传遍了学校。

example.english: Please stand behind the yellow line.
example.chinese: 请站在黄线后面。

example.chinese: 电影将在五分钟后开始。

example.english: We stayed at a small hotel near the lake.
example.chinese: 我们住在湖边的一家小旅馆。

example.chinese: 偷别人的东西是不对的。

example.english: The first step is to wash your hands.
example.chinese: 第一步是洗手。

example.english: Stick the label on the front of the box.
example.chinese: 把标签贴在箱子正面。

example.english: The rain stopped before the game began.
example.chinese: 比赛开始前雨停了。

example.english: I heard a strange noise in the kitchen.
example.chinese: 我听到厨房里有奇怪的声音。

example.chinese: 我们的教练对安全要求很严格。

example.english: Regular exercise makes your body strong.
example.chinese: 经常锻炼会让你的身体强壮。

example.chinese: 我们每个工作日都学习英语。

example.english: Science is my favourite subject.
example.chinese: 科学是我最喜欢的学科。

example.english: You can succeed if you keep trying.
example.chinese: 只要坚持尝试，你就能成功。

example.english: Hard work was the key to her success.
example.chinese: 努力是她成功的关键。

example.english: I have never seen such a bright star.
example.chinese: 我从未见过这样明亮的星星。

example.english: A sudden storm forced us to go home.
example.chinese: 一场突如其来的暴风雨迫使我们回家。

example.english: I suggest taking the earlier train.
example.chinese: 我建议乘坐更早的一班火车。

example.english: My family supports my decision.
example.chinese: 我的家人支持我的决定。

example.english: I am sure we took the correct road.
example.chinese: 我确信我们走的是正确的路。

example.english: The party was a lovely surprise for Dad.
example.chinese: 这场聚会给了爸爸一个美好的惊喜。

example.english: We swim at the sports centre on Sundays.
example.chinese: 我们每周日在体育中心游泳。

example.chinese: 请随身带一把伞。

example.chinese: 课后我们谈了各自的计划。

example.english: The soup tastes better with some salt.
example.chinese: 这汤加点盐尝起来更好。

example.chinese: 李老师教我们怎样种蔬菜。

example.english: Please tell me when you arrive.
example.chinese: 你到了以后请告诉我。

example.chinese: 这条路比另一条路短。

example.chinese: 我感谢玛雅的热心帮助。

example.chinese: 我认为这个计划会奏效。

example.chinese: 我们一起穿过森林。

example.chinese: 请不要把垃圾扔在地上。

example.chinese: 我们还有时间赶上公交车。

example.chinese: 走了很久之后，我感到疲倦。

example.chinese: 她走向窗户。

example.chinese: 不要触摸未干的油漆。

example.chinese: 制作灯笼是当地的传统。

example.english: The train leaves at half past eight.
example.chinese: 火车八点半出发。

example.english: My family plans to travel by train.
example.chinese: 我的家人计划乘火车旅行。

example.chinese: 我们应该尊重地对待每个人。

example.chinese: 如果完成任务有困难，就请教老师。

example.chinese: 这个故事是真的还是编的？

example.chinese: 我相信朋友会归还这本书。

example.chinese: 先试试这个简单的方法。

example.chinese: 在第二个十字路口左转。
